Home

Capabilities
CNC machining capabilities

Choose a route by part geometry, material or project stage.

Machining processes
Materials
Project stages
Choose by part geometry

Custom CNC machining for prototypes and small production runs. The drawing and setup constraints determine the proposed route.

CNC milling

Pockets, flat faces and hole patterns in blocks, brackets and housings.

CNC turning

Shafts, sleeves and fittings built around an axis, with shoulders, bores and threads.

5-axis machining

Angled faces and continuous contours needing access from several directions.

Machining of castings

Finished bores, sealing faces and mounting datums in a supplied cast blank.

Source reference forms. Material, tolerances and supply scope follow the approved drawing.

Start with the material

Specify the exact grade, condition and finish. If these are undecided, bring the application requirements for review.

Material stock concept · AI illustration, not a grade certificate
Aluminum

Alloy and temper, thin sections and the dimensions after finishing.

Stainless steel

Grade and condition selected for the service environment and treatment.

Copper & brass

Contact, heat-transfer or sealing requirements, with the alloy standard defined.

Engineering plastics

Polymer and fillers, working conditions and the dimensional inspection state.

Source collection examples; appearance does not identify the alloy or polymer grade.

What information do you have today?
AI-generated sample-to-drawing concept; not an approved drawing or reconstruction record.

A current design needs a fit, assembly, appearance or functional check. An agreed revision, evaluation scope and reviewable result.

Approved drawings are ready for a release by part number and quantity. A production baseline with first-article approval, sampling and traceability.

Specify grade, condition, finish and the final acceptance state together. These are discussion options; suitability and availability are confirmed for the drawing.

Material & specification	Finish / treatment	Confirm for this drawing
Aluminum

Specify alloy and temper; examples include 6061 and 7075.

	Deburring, polishing, bead blasting or anodizing.	Mark protected fits and dimensions that apply after treatment.
Steel & stainless steel

Specify the exact grade, stock condition and any heat treatment.

	Machined surfaces, polishing or a compatible protective treatment.	Identify working interfaces, burr limits and required material records.
Copper & brass

Specify the alloy and standard for contacts or fittings.

	Polishing or compatible plating.	Define contact areas, threads and post-plating dimensions.
Engineering plastics

Specify polymer grade, fillers and stock condition.

	Machined surfaces with agreed edge quality and cleaning.	Include application conditions and the measurement state.

Define the critical features

Selected critical features
±0.01 mm

This reference applies only to selected features after reviewing the material, geometry, setup and measurement method. Confirm each critical tolerance on the drawing; ±0.01 mm does not apply to every feature or part.

Feature	Specify on the drawing	Agree before production

Finish & protected areas	Finish, masking, cosmetic faces and dimensions that apply before or after treatment.	Agree the acceptance stage and required finishing records. Define cleanliness, chemical-contact or ESD tests separately.

Agricultural machinery
Include operating conditions with housing and bracket drawings. Shafts and their rotational features are reviewed through CNC turning.
Semiconductor equipment
Define cleanliness, chemical exposure and any ESD limits for equipment housings and interfaces. Specify the tests and documentation required for the application.

These are component review requirements, not sector approvals or customer-project claims.

Original LZZ CMM photograph. Confirm current range, calibration and measurement capability from the equipment records.

Current 3D model and drawing, part number, units and revision.

Material grade, stock condition and stock dimensions.

Mating features, datums, holes, thin walls and permitted geometry or radius changes.

Acceptance & delivery

Finish, masking, post-treatment acceptance and any required tests or records.

Quantity, delivery destination and requested date.

Minimum order
1 piece
Production
7–14 business days
